name: ObjectOne Information Systems Limited
about: ObjectOne Information Systems Limited engages in the provision of technology consulting and software development services in India and internationally. It offers HRMSOne, a human resource management software. The company also provides Objectone ERP, a business software solution for companies to manage the attributes of the inventory. In addition, it offers business consulting, analytics, enterprise mobile application, social relationship management, enterprise application, supply chain management, engineering, and quality assurance services. The company serves customers across various verticals, such as banking, insurance, professional services, media, telecommunications, healthcare, etc. ObjectOne Information Systems Limited was incorporated in 1996 and is based in Hyderabad, India.
